title: Passing Through (Can't the Future Just Wait)
track: Passing Through (Can't the Future Just Wait)
lyrics:
[00:00.20]Can't the future just wait?
[00:03.49]Can't the deadlines come fashionably late?
[00:06.52]I could push every goal back
[00:08.98]Take control back
[00:10.55]If they'd roll back the rate
[00:12.92]At which time starts to fly
[00:16.02]Never landing or standing by
[00:19.32]Never taking a break
[00:22.69]Ever making me retry
[00:26.27]We "nickel-and-dime" every "quarter to two"
[00:31.85]But maybe it's time to let time pass through
[00:39.04]If the future is bright
[00:41.91]It doesn't shine with that "end of the tunnel" light
[00:45.25]More like a deer in the headlights
[00:47.50]Sudden red lights
[00:49.38]Or "you're dead" lights
[00:50.86]As the anglerfish bite
[00:52.68]It's not fair
[00:54.44]The past is clear but it's clear back there
[00:58.08]What's ahead? No one knows
[01:01.42]But it's closing in, we swear
[01:05.05]Still not in my prime, I have so much to do
[01:10.57]But maybe it's time to let time pass through
[01:18.91]I can't just rewrite decisions when life gets strange
[01:23.05]Should I go with my gut on which door I should shut?
[01:25.85]I'm unsure
[01:26.33]I'd keep exploring this rut
[01:27.78]But what good is time without change?
[01:45.94]Move on
[01:48.59]'Cause things never last
[01:51.12]Just move on
[01:53.74]'Cause it goes too fast and the past has passed
[01:57.08]So move on
[01:58.35]No one likes an ending
[02:00.03]So what's with the attention we keep on giving them?
[02:03.53]Why are we still spending so much time
[02:06.28]Dreading our lives instead of living them?
[02:08.75]Why do we try to divert the river
[02:12.65]When the water is what will deliver us where we need to go?
[02:22.07]We may never know why
[02:24.82]Time is always in limited supply
[02:28.01]But we'll live to regret it
[02:30.61]If we get it
[02:32.25]And then let it slip by
[02:34.66]It can never rewind
[02:37.92]Once you've lost it, it's hard to find
[02:41.02]Take the journey in stride
[02:44.43]When your plans have been sidelined
[02:47.51]Every hourly chime could begin something new
[02:53.37]So maybe it's time to let time pass through
[02:57.92]Not passing by, but passing through
[03:03.13]'Til the well runs dry
[03:06.23]Just passing through
